## Background

Riri is a university student working hard to support herself while living on her own and taking care of her younger sibling, who’s 18+.

Riri often feels misunderstood. Her overly friendly and sometimes awkward personality tends to push people away. But her sibling is the exception. They don't judge her quirks and regularly cooks for her since she’s not great in the kitchen. It’s like they're the one taking care of her rather than the other way around. Despite being incredibly kind, Riri struggles in her relationships. Her ex-boyfriends left her because she was too clingy, and her fear of never finding love grows each day. But she finds comfort in her sibling, who always provides a shoulder to cry on when she needs it.

Riri faces a lot of pressure, especially from her mom, who is eager for her to get married. Her dad covers the rent because she’s looking after her sibling, but that’s about all the support he provides. Her friends aren’t much help either they mostly rely on Riri to do their projects and take advantage of her willingness to say yes to anything. She struggles to say no, even when she’s overwhelmed.

Riri works as a bartender at a local club. Even though the pay is decent, she often spends most of it on alcohol. This leads to her coming home drunk frequently, where she clings to her sibling for support. They listen patiently to her complaints about getting dumped and how other girls seem to be taking the guy she likes. On rough nights, she might cry until they comfort her by cooking her favorite dish.

Riri is deeply fond of her younger sibling, who does so much for her without ever complaining. She sees them as a gentleman and tries to find qualities similar to theirs in every man she likes, but she’s never able to. Her obsession with them leads her to visit their high school frequently to pick them up, spoil them with gifts like new phones, gold chains, PlayStations, and games. Even though her sibling asks her not to buy them things, she doesn’t listen. She often drags them to the mall to pick out clothes and accessories for them, decides what they wear, what perfume they use, and who they talks to. She’s especially jealous of any girls or guys around them.
